## Description
Provide a clear description of the changes introduced in this Pull Request.

## Type of Change
Select the appropriate label for this PR (required for automated version bump):
- [ ] `patch` — Bug fix / minor correction (bumps `vX.Y.Z+1`)
- [ ] `minor` — New feature / non-breaking enhancement (bumps `vX.Y+1.0`)
- [ ] `major` — Breaking change (bumps `vX+1.0.0`)

## Checklist
- [ ] I have run `pytest` and all unit tests pass locally.
- [ ] I have updated documentation or `README.md` if applicable.
- [ ] My changes maintain backwards compatibility (unless labeled `major`).
